folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B302: genre evidence and retained payoff
folds.body:
The full original 135-line dossier was read, including every genre table, bounded shortlist, five proposed priorities and bookshelf follow-up. Its Reddit/Royal Road sample is purposive and self-selecting, not a measure of general popularity or Weibao's preferences. Reader praise/criticism supplies a discovery lead; author essays, publisher synopses, a glossary and actual chapter evidence support different claims. None is newly checked by this review. Preserve the unsuccessful canonical fetch and specific exact-text gaps instead of upgrading them through a later title citation.

Keep the central design freedom: straightforward earned power, a surviving mentor, a competent rival, a useful ordinary craft, quiet long-term research or overwhelming success can all work. An inversion is another possible trope, not an obligation to disappoint or devalue a reward. Larger strength can make old threats easy; complementary expertise matters when its mechanism is useful, without inventing a problem that cancels the strong faculty. Numerical growth, functional change and source/knowledge/authority differences need actual readers. Trust, reputation, allegiance and obligation remain different relationships, and neither a companion nor a guild requires a whole simulated population before its first useful role.

Systems, forecasts, regression, private supply and several selves are distinct powers, not a bundle or mandatory acquisition chain. Memory does not recreate another person's trust, a forecast is not lived history, and an actor's knowledge/report is not global world truth. Fully functional copied/innate faculties can use their own acquisition rule. Cosmic/world laws, bodies, direct settings and noncombat paths retain their particular source and era; editorial genre labels are search tools rather than a shared ladder or permission list.

The old five-priority order, one-realm/prestige prerequisite and ordinary-event-with-two-approaches gate are dated planning scope. Current [project focus](../PROJECT.md#current-focus), AD44/AD51/AD52 and selected world owners govern actual development. Broad genre possibilities remain preserved without new research, migration, casting or runtime dispatch. The earlier bookshelf synopsis/scene counts are not whole-series reading or automatically unselected today; the shelf owner's later specific original deliveries keep their own evidence. No source module, primary novel/forum, gameplay, build or browser claim is renewed here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B302: generated demonstrations and real other selves
folds.body:
The complete original 280-line palette was read. Weibao's soul/face/habit recognition, same-or-different outcomes, any-source delivery and world-dependent intensity answers remain established; do not ask the old Q1/Q2 as global either/or choices. The particular G1–G9 forms, transforms, source costs and emotional effects are illustrations. The cited perfect-fight chapter is this owner's attributed research example, not a new primary read or proof that every demonstration grants a faculty.

Keep ontology and presentation separate. A generated optimal/added-ability/conditional-future/shadow projection is not a real person with independent property merely because it looks like one. A real past/future visitor requires actual branch/body/actor history and carrier rules. The later G4 possibility of meeting a real alternate person is a separate instantiated route, not proof that all G1–G7 are always harmless simulations or that any forecast can become a live actor by changing a label. Common swords/methods, an exact unique object, a transferred source and a copied pattern follow different identity/custody mechanisms. The listed fade/merge/coexist responses are local possibilities, not a universal singleton/duplication law.

Optimal means an explicit objective under known/available means: safest, cheapest, fastest, mercy or another authored goal. A bounded search finding no line proves no line in its searched scope; it does not prove the fight mathematically unwinnable or that a real source-perfect faculty is inherently inaccurate. Preserve actual source knowledge and legitimately supernatural insight when supported. A technology recorder does not learn a hidden future move from development state. Demonstration, simulation and live guidance can have different scope, accuracy and audiences. The current native combat state space and off-main-thread suggestion are historical assumptions, not measured feasible optimization or a selected worker architecture.

Observation/understanding, a practice boost and actual power acquisition have their own source rules. The Rat-step sequence is an example, not a universal barrier to a source that genuinely grants execution. Rare/heavy-cost live guidance, dependence, addiction, repeated-learning decay, forced flaws and counters are dials, including none; do not impose them to nerf an effective faculty. A rival learns from actually available recordings/evidence and has real time/resources to act, not access to private player intention. A creator/host/patron or institution can differ in which projection it supplies and who sees it.

A seed/transform/summary is not sufficient to regenerate an exact demonstration after content/resolver/inputs change. Preserve the selected source/definition revision, initial state, actually committed draws/decisions and outcome identity as needed by its consumer. Pinned history and conditional future remain different evidence. A replay cannot consume or grant from live campaign stock merely by displaying it; a separately admitted actor or training reward uses the real command/publication route. A generated future's assets, trust, skill or achievements are not retroactively player-earned. Optional replay remains optional and real player controls stay usable.

Personal intensity here means the fictional character's supported in-game history. It does not authorize importing Weibao's actual memories, private life or personal data as a shadow's content. Keep altered/world-private truths sealed outside their discovery route. Current compatibility, current developer/ordinary-life distinction and actual body/world/observer rules govern selected work. No replay, forecast, real-person identity, new combat/state/search mechanism, source qualification, runtime or save evidence is created by this review.
